Joint Demat Account
Two or More Holders · Not Available
IIFL Securities does not support joint demat or joint trading accounts. SEBI regulations permit joint demat accounts at depositories, but IIFL Securities' account structure does not offer this option. Each investor must hold a separate individual demat account. If you specifically require a joint demat account, consider ICICI Securities or other full-service brokers that offer this facility via NSDL/CDSL.

Foreign National / OCI (Non-Resident, Non-NRI)
Foreign Passport Holders · Full Foreign Nationals · Not Available
Foreign nationals (holding non-Indian passports) and OCI holders who are not classified as NRIs (i.e., not Indian-origin persons with prior Indian residency or earnings) cannot open trading accounts at IIFL Securities. IIFL Securities' NRI onboarding is structured for Indian-origin non-residents via the PIS route. Foreigners wishing to invest in Indian markets must use the FPI (Foreign Portfolio Investor) route, registered separately with SEBI through a designated custodian.

Advantages & Disadvantages

Pros & Cons

An honest assessment of where IIFL Securities excels and where it falls short compared to discount brokers in 2026.

✅
Advantages
  • ✓₹0 Account Opening for All: Unlike HDFC Securities (₹999 for non-HDFC users), IIFL Securities offers free account opening to all customers — no bank relationship required.
  • ✓NPS Available on Platform: IIFL Securities offers National Pension Scheme (NPS) investing directly on its platform — a major advantage over HDFC Securities and several other full-service brokers.
  • ✓In-House Research: SEBI-registered equity research covering 300+ stocks with daily reports, model portfolios, F&O strategies, and sector analysis — unavailable at discount brokers.
  • ✓Lower Demat AMC: ₹250/yr Demat AMC — significantly lower than HDFC Securities' ₹750/yr and ICICI Securities' ₹400/yr, making it more affordable for buy-and-hold investors.
  • ✓2,600+ Branch Network: IIFL has one of the largest branch networks among full-service brokers, providing strong in-person support across tier-2 and tier-3 cities.
  • ✓Pro Plan Competitiveness: The flat ₹20/order Pro Plan is competitive with Zerodha and Upstox — traders can get full-service reliability at discount broker pricing.
  • ✓NRI Onboarding Without Bank Tie-up: Unlike HDFC Securities, IIFL Securities does not require a specific bank relationship for NRI accounts — broader accessibility for overseas investors.
⚠️
Limitations
  • ✗Basic Plan is Expensive: Default 0.55% delivery brokerage is significantly higher than Zerodha (₹0), Groww (₹0), or even ICICI Securities (₹20 flat). New users are automatically enrolled in the Basic Plan.
  • ✗Smaller Market Share than Peers: 1.90% NSE market share puts IIFL Securities below HDFC (3.10%), Kotak (2.80%), and SBICAP (2.40%) — indicating slower growth momentum vs bank-backed peers.
  • ✗No Bank Integration (Unlike HDFC/ICICI/Kotak): IIFL Securities lacks a 3-in-1 bank + demat + trading account — fund transfers require NEFT/UPI or net banking without the instant sweep benefits of HDFC Securities.
  • ✗No Native Algo Trading Tool: No built-in strategy automation tool like Zerodha Streak — IIFL Securities lacks a no-code algo platform for retail traders.
  • ✗No Joint Accounts: IIFL Securities does not support joint demat or trading accounts — limiting household joint investment management options.
  • ✗Platform UX vs Discount Brokers: IIFL Markets platform lags behind Zerodha Kite and Groww in mobile UX polish and simplicity — can be overwhelming for first-time investors.

Final Verdict

IIFL Securities: Best for Research-Driven Investors & NPS Seekers
